coordinate_system: Top-left pixel origin, x right, y down. Anchors and muzzle points local to cell. pico2d_clip_rect uses bottom-left image origin.
facing: right. Left-facing mirror uses local x = 256 - x.

palette.parry_effect: black graphite and white, no pink

render_reference.note: Apply uniform scale to complete cell and register virtual sole to player bottom. Tail and ears can extend beyond collision bounds.

idle_horizontal.after: resume base animation at current movement phase

idle_up.after: resume base animation at current movement phase

aliases.parry_failure: fall_lowered or matching current fall aim
aliases.run_diagonal_recoil: choose recoil left_contact/right_contact for current phase

transitions.parry_failure: ordinary matching fall pose after attempt timeout, no failure recoil
transitions.jump_rise: hold final frame until apex then matching fall
transitions.death: play once then hold last frame
transitions.hurt: play 0.125s then resume locomotion; existing game handles invincibility blink
transitions.recoil: each firing recoil is a separate 0.05s frame, then resume base movement
transitions.parry_attempt: four 0.04s frames, total0.16s; success interrupts immediately
transitions.parry_success_launch: 0.15s curled launch then ascent while vy>0, falling when vy<=0; physics provides world movement

normalization.strategy: Fixed scale per source atlas, standing reference height160; airborne scale matched with measured eye height. Alpha bounds trimmed with margin. Sole and rotation registration shared.

limitations: Generated pencil linework and body proportions retain small variations.
Muzzle coordinates are silhouette estimates and require calibration when integrated with projectile spawning.
Strict anatomical left/right limb symmetry is not manually rigged.

validation.muzzle_positions: Estimated from visible silhouettes; not calibrated against gameplay.
